name: 72719 · Centerton, AR
findings: ZIP 72719 (Centerton) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72719 (Centerton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
